headline: Prepare reviewed Desk images before delivery and finish release acceptance

items.title: Prepare and verify Desk article images before email delivery
items.insight: Add an explicit no-send preparation and preview command using the existing art workflow. Require reviewed image sources and exact served image bytes before actual Desk dispatch, and carry story/kind scope through review and ingest. Preserve arming, idempotency and existing subscription behavior without sending emails during implementation.
items.evidence: docs/S413_DESK_EMAIL_PLAN.json; source preverification and original S413 findings.
